verses.original: Τὸ λοιπόν ἀδελφοί μου χαίρετε ἐν Κυρίῳ τὰ αὐτὰ γράφειν ὑμῖν ἐμοὶ μὲν οὐκ ὀκνηρόν ὑμῖν δὲ ἀσφαλές
verses.transliteration: To loipon adelphoi mou chairete en Kyriō ta auta graphein hymin emoi men ouk oknēron hymin de asphales
verses.literal: Finally my brothers rejoice in the Lord It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again and it is a safeguard for you

verses.original: Βλέπετε τοὺς κύνας βλέπετε τοὺς κακοὺς ἐργάτας βλέπετε τὴν κατατομήν
verses.transliteration: Blepete tous kynas blepete tous kakous ergatas blepete tēn katatomēn
verses.literal: Watch out for those dogs those workers of evil those mutilators of the flesh

verses.original: ἡμεῖς γάρ ἐσμεν ἡ περιτομή οἱ Πνεύματι Θεοῦ λατρεύοντες καὶ καυχώμενοι ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐν σαρκὶ πεποιθότες
verses.transliteration: hēmeis gar esmen hē peritomē hoi Pneumati Theou latreuontes kai kauchōmenoi en Christō Iēsou kai ouk en sarki pepoithotes
verses.literal: For it is we who are the circumcision we who worship by the Spirit of God who glory in Christ Jesus and who put no confidence in the flesh

verses.original: καίπερ ἐγὼ ἔχων πεποίθησιν καὶ ἐν σαρκί Εἴ τις δοκεῖ ἄλλος πεποιθέναι ἐν σαρκί ἐγὼ μᾶλλον
verses.transliteration: kaiper egō echōn pepoithēsin kai en sarki Ei tis dokei allos pepoithenai en sarki egō mallon
verses.literal: though I myself . . . could have such confidence . . . . . . If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh I have more

verses.original: περιτομῇ ὀκταήμερος ἐκ γένους Ἰσραήλ φυλῆς Βενιαμίν Ἑβραῖος ἐξ Ἑβραίων κατὰ νόμον Φαρισαῖος
verses.transliteration: peritomē oktaēmeros ek genous Israēl phylēs Beniamin Hebraios ex Hebraiōn kata nomon Pharisaios
verses.literal: circumcised on the eighth day of the people of Israel of the tribe of Benjamin a Hebrew of Hebrews as to the law a Pharisee

verses.original: κατὰ ζῆλος διώκων τὴν ἐκκλησίαν κατὰ δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐν νόμῳ γενόμενος ἄμεμπτος
verses.transliteration: kata zēlos diōkōn tēn ekklēsian kata dikaiosynēn tēn en nomō genomenos amemptos
verses.literal: as to zeal persecuting the church as to righteousness in the law faultless

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ ἅτινα ἦν μοι κέρδη ταῦτα ἥγημαι διὰ τὸν Χριστὸν ζημίαν
verses.transliteration: Alla hatina ēn moi kerdē tauta hēgēmai dia ton Christon zēmian
verses.literal: But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ

verses.original: ἀλλὰ μὲν‿ οὖν‿ γε καὶ ἡγοῦμαι πάντα ζημίαν εἶναι διὰ τὸ ὑπερέχον τῆς γνώσεως Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου μου δι’ ὃν τὰ πάντα ἐζημιώθην καὶ ἡγοῦμαι σκύβαλα ἵνα Χριστὸν κερδήσω
verses.transliteration: alla men oun ge kai hēgoumai panta zēmian einai dia to hyperechon tēs gnōseōs Christou Iēsou tou Kyriou mou di’ hon ta panta ezēmiōthēn kai hēgoumai skybala hina Christon kerdēsō
verses.literal: More than that . . . . . . . . . . . . I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord for whom I have lost all things I consider them rubbish that I may gain Christ

verses.original: καὶ εὑρεθῶ ἐν αὐτῷ μὴ ἔχων ἐμὴν δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐκ νόμου ἀλλὰ τὴν διὰ πίστεως Χριστοῦ τὴν ἐκ Θεοῦ δικαιοσύνην ἐπὶ τῇ πίστει
verses.transliteration: kai heurethō en autō mē echōn emēn dikaiosynēn tēn ek nomou alla tēn dia pisteōs Christou tēn ek Theou dikaiosynēn epi tē pistei
verses.literal: and be found in Him not having my own righteousness from the law but that which is through faith in Christ the righteousness from God on the basis of faith

verses.original: τοῦ γνῶναι αὐτὸν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν τῆς ἀναστάσεως αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν κοινωνίαν τῶν παθημάτων αὐτοῦ συμμορφιζόμενος τῷ θανάτῳ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: tou gnōnai auton kai tēn dynamin tēs anastaseōs autou kai tēn koinōnian tōn pathēmatōn autou symmorphizomenos tō thanatō autou
verses.literal: I want to know Christ and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings being conformed to Him in His death

verses.original: εἴ πως καταντήσω εἰς τὴν ἐξανάστασιν τὴν ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: ei pōs katantēsō eis tēn exanastasin tēn ek nekrōn
verses.literal: and so somehow to attain to the resurrection from the dead

verses.original: Οὐχ ὅτι ἤδη ἔλαβον ἢ ἤδη τετελείωμαι διώκω δὲ εἰ καὶ καταλάβω ἐφ’ ᾧ καὶ κατελήμφθην ὑπὸ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ouch hoti ēdē elabon ē ēdē teteleiōmai diōkō de ei kai katalabō eph’ hō kai katelēmphthēn hypo Christou Iēsou
verses.literal: Not that I have already obtained all this or have already been made perfect but I press on - to take hold of that for which . . . Christ Jesus took hold of me

verses.original: ἀδελφοί ἐγὼ ἐμαυτὸν οὐ λογίζομαι κατειληφέναι ἓν δέ τὰ μὲν ὀπίσω ἐπιλανθανόμενος τοῖς δὲ ἔμπροσθεν ἐπεκτεινόμενος
verses.transliteration: adelphoi egō emauton ou logizomai kateilēphenai hen de ta men opisō epilanthanomenos tois de emprosthen epekteinomenos
verses.literal: Brothers I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it But one thing I do Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead

verses.original: κατὰ σκοπὸν διώκω εἰς τὸ βραβεῖον τῆς ἄνω κλήσεως τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: kata skopon diōkō eis to brabeion tēs anō klēseōs tou Theou en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus

verses.original: Ὅσοι οὖν τέλειοι τοῦτο φρονῶμεν καὶ εἴ τι ἑτέρως φρονεῖτε καὶ τοῦτο ὁ Θεὸς ὑμῖν ἀποκαλύψει
verses.transliteration: Hosoi oun teleioi touto phronōmen kai ei ti heterōs phroneite kai touto ho Theos hymin apokalypsei
verses.literal: All of us who are mature should embrace this point of view And if you think differently about some issue God will reveal this to you as well

verses.original: πλὴν εἰς ὃ ἐφθάσαμεν τῷ αὐτῷ στοιχεῖν
verses.transliteration: plēn eis ho ephthasamen tō autō stoichein
verses.literal: Nevertheless we must live up . . . . . . to what we have already attained

verses.original: Συμμιμηταί μου γίνεσθε ἀδελφοί καὶ σκοπεῖτε τοὺς οὕτω περιπατοῦντας καθὼς ἔχετε τύπον ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Symmimētai mou ginesthe adelphoi kai skopeite tous houtō peripatountas kathōs echete typon hēmas
verses.literal: Join one another in following . . . my example brothers and carefully observe those who walk according to the pattern we set for you . . .

verses.original: πολλοὶ γὰρ περιπατοῦσιν οὓς πολλάκις ἔλεγον ὑμῖν νῦν δὲ καὶ κλαίων λέγω τοὺς ἐχθροὺς τοῦ σταυροῦ τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: polloi gar peripatousin hous pollakis elegon hymin nyn de kai klaiōn legō tous echthrous tou staurou tou Christou
verses.literal: For as I have often told . . . you before and now say again even with tears Many live as enemies of the cross of Christ

verses.original: ὧν τὸ τέλος ἀπώλεια ὧν ὁ θεὸς ἡ κοιλία καὶ ἡ δόξα ἐν τῇ αἰσχύνῃ αὐτῶν οἱ τὰ ἐπίγεια φρονοῦντες
verses.transliteration: hōn to telos apōleia hōn ho theos hē koilia kai hē doxa en tē aischynē autōn hoi ta epigeia phronountes
verses.literal: Their end is destruction their god is their belly and their glory is in their shame Their minds are set on earthly things

verses.original: Ἡμῶν γὰρ τὸ πολίτευμα ἐν οὐρανοῖς ὑπάρχει ἐξ οὗ καὶ Σωτῆρα ἀπεκδεχόμεθα Κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν
verses.transliteration: Hēmōn gar to politeuma en ouranois hyparchei ex hou kai Sōtēra apekdechometha Kyrion Iēsoun Christon
verses.literal: But our citizenship is in heaven and we eagerly await a Savior from there the Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: ὃς μετασχηματίσει τὸ σῶμα τῆς ταπεινώσεως ἡμῶν σύμμορφον τῷ σώματι τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τοῦ δύνασθαι αὐτὸν καὶ ὑποτάξαι αὑτῷ τὰ πάντα
verses.transliteration: hos metaschēmatisei to sōma tēs tapeinōseōs hēmōn symmorphon tō sōmati tēs doxēs autou kata tēn energeian tou dynasthai auton kai hypotaxai hautō ta panta
verses.literal: who by the power that enables Him . . . to subject all things to Himself will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body
